lines.text: Astra moves now: a poster flies into its title's page, and the player opens out of the stream you tap. No cuts to black.
Stream cards are designed: resolution, picture, sound, size and release at a glance, in the order you choose.
Settings can be searched and has far more: accent, text size, motion, haptics, player buttons, hiding spoilers.
Settings › About has Copy feel report: it shows which transitions stutter on your phone, so they can be fixed.
